description_html:
The Vaporesso GTX Coil is a replacement coil for compatible Vaporesso devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: Mesh & Dual Mesh, 0.15Ω-0.6Ω
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: Vaporesso Target PM80, Swag PX80, Luxe PM40, GTX Go, GTX Tank, GTX One, Luxe XR / XR Max, Armour G, GEN PT 80S/60S
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: Vaporesso

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: MESH 0.2OHM, MESH 0.3OHM, MESH 0.6OHM, MESH 0.8OHM, MESH 0.15OHM, MESH 0.4 OHM, DUAL MESH 0.15OHM, DUAL MESH 0.2OHM, DUAL MESH 0.3OHM.
